local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local checkpoint = script.Parent
local checkpointOrder = checkpoint:GetAttribute("CheckpointIndex") or 1

local function onCharacterAdded(player, character)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local stageValue = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Stage")
	if stageValue and stageValue.Value == checkpointOrder then
		local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
		if rootPart then
			task.defer(function()
				if character.Parent and rootPart.Parent then
					rootPart.CFrame = checkpoint.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		onCharacterAdded(player, character)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local checkpoint = script.Parent
local sound = script:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sound")

local checkpointOrder = checkpoint:GetAttribute("CheckpointIndex") or 1
local activatedPlayers = {}

local function playActivationFeedback()
	if sound and sound.SoundId ~= "" then
		sound:Play()
	end
	
	local initialColor = checkpoint.Color
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, true)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(checkpoint, tweenInfo, {
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 255, 255),
		Transparency = 0.2
	})
	tween:Play()
end

local function onTouched(hit)
	local character = hit and hit.Parent
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player then return end
	
	local userId = player.UserId
	if activatedPlayers[userId] then return end
	
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local stageValue = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Stage")
	if not stageValue then return end
	
	if stageValue.Value == checkpointOrder - 1 then
		stageValue.Value = checkpointOrder
		activatedPlayers[userId] = true
		playActivationFeedback()
	end
end

checkpoint.Touched:Connect(onTouched)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	activatedPlayers[player.UserId] = nil
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function setupLeaderstats(player)
	if player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") then return end
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	
	local stage = Instance.new("IntValue")
	stage.Name = "Stage"
	stage.Value = 0
	stage.Parent = leaderstats
	
	leaderstats.Parent = player
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupLeaderstats)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	setupLeaderstats(player)
end
